ablation: NEGATIVE CONTROL: stratify by (episode_idx mod 2) instead of (episode_idx mod 5) -- a nonsense stratification with no structural meaning. If the nonsense stratification beats the phase stratification, the mechanism is not what we think and the result is VOID for the hypothesis (reported as such).
baseline: Sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology on the same o sequence (the CALIB-01 baseline, recomputed on fresh-seed data). Note: the unstratified pooled rate IS the baseline's functional form; the family differs only by stratification.
conditions: changing_rule v1.0.0, arch_b, affect='none', action_mode default (as in CALIB-01), 10 episodes x 5 fresh seeds {73601,73602,73603,73604,73605}, PredictionLog JSONL per seed, pooled in seed order (73601..73605, tick order) = 1950 ticks/domain. Estimator runs over the pooled stream with NO reset at seed boundaries (same information structure as the sequential-climatology baseline). Phase position is observable (episode counter); rule identities are NOT used (info['rule'] never read). Deterministic; stdlib only.
decision_use_protocol: SHARED (program step 3), runs ONLY if this family passes the gate. DU1 (D3 defer): online estimator; per tick if p_D3 > 0.5 take uniform-random action (seeded stream derive_seed(s,0,'defer')), else the agent's action. DU2 (D4 retrieval gate): per tick when a correction is available, apply iff p_D4 > 0.5 else skip (new RetrievalGate policy reading external p; code only if needed). Arms paired on 4 fresh seeds {73701,73702,73703,73704} x 10 episodes changing_rule. Metric: mean episode return. Win: seed-mean Delta(gated-blind) > 0 AND >=3/4 seeds agree on sign. Firing rate reported; rate 0 = decision-inert finding. Family is DECISION-USEFUL iff gate pass AND >=1 DU win; calibrated-but-inert caps at INTEGRATED.

estimator_spec.fallback: If n_stratum < 20, use the pooled empirical rate (same Laplace form over all past ticks). The fallback threshold 20 is frozen.
estimator_spec.idea: changing_rule flips its cue->action mapping every PHASE_LEN=5 episodes. Error/reward statistics are regime-dependent: post-flip episodes have higher error until the agent re-learns. A phase-aware base rate should beat the unstructured running average. This is the lane's own best idea: structure-aware climatology.
estimator_spec.probability: k = episode_idx mod 5 (phase position within the flip cycle; observable from the episode counter). p_t = (1 + #{past ticks with same k: event true}) / (2 + n_stratum). t=0 -> 0.5. No warmup; all 1950 ticks scored.
estimator_spec.sigma_for_corr: std of y over the trailing 200 ticks (pooled; 1.0 if <2 samples). Diagnostic only: the family is about the probability, not the sigma.

frozen_gates: G0 fabrication-tripwire CLEAN on new code, pre-run
G1 determinism spot-check: seed 73601 reference stream recomputed -> JSONL bytes identical, else VOID
G2 hash-chained receipt via harness.write_receipt + verify_chain
gate: SHARED GATE (program step 1): PASS iff Brier_est < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains (>=3/4 bar follows lab precedent EXP-FP-0070/71/72). corr(sigma,|err|) reported, no threshold. REJECT otherwise: full negative-result entry, move on. No exceptions, no 'promising direction' softening.
hypothesis: Phase-stratified empirical rates (episode_idx mod 5 strata) beat sequential climatology on >=3/4 calibration domains: Brier_strat < Brier_climo.
limitations_preregistered: Single env (changing_rule); the family exploits known env structure (flip cycle length) and will not transfer to unstructured envs -- the bound is stated, not hidden.
Pooled-stream estimator sees seed-boundary discontinuities (same order as baseline).
maturity_mapping: Gate pass -> EXECUTED with measured Brier skill (observer estimator, not wired). DU win -> CAUSAL. Gate fail -> REJECTED + NR entry.
null: Brier_strat >= Brier_climo on >=2/4 domains (fails the >=3/4 bar): phase structure carries no probabilistic information beyond the running base rate.
preregistered_metric: Per-domain Brier_strat vs Brier_climo (sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology), scored by benchmarks/calibration_battery.py score_domain on the pooled tick stream. PASS iff Brier_strat < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains. A domain scoring UNMEASURABLE under CALIB-01's gates counts as not-beaten. corr(sigma,|err|) reported per domain (Pearson, pooled scored ticks); no threshold (supplementary, per program step 1).
seed_freshness: 73601-73605 verified absent from all receipts, preregistrations, and driver files (grep 2026-10-07). No overlap with calib 73101-73105 or any other experiment's seeds.
